senses.gloss:
m. (-शः)
1 Race, lineage, family.
2 Assemblage, multitude.
3 A bambu.
4 The back-bone, the spine.
mf. (-शः-शी)
1 A pipe, a fife, a flute.
2 Bambu manna.
E.
वंश to shine, घ aff., and नुम् augment; or वन् to sound, to serve, aff. श.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Bambu, of or belonging to, made from a bambu, &c.
f. (-शी)
The manna of the bambu.
E.
वंश a bambu, and अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A small fish, (Cynoglossus lingua, HAM.)
2 A large kind of sugar-cane.
nf. (-शकं-शिका)
Aloe wood.
f. (-का)
A kind of pipe or flute.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

n. (-फं)
Flocks of cotton or cottony pods floating in the air.
E.
वंश a bambu, and कफ phlegm.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Making or perpetuating a family.
E.
वंश, and कर what makes.

mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति)
Famous, celebrated.
E.
वंश, and कीर्त्ति fame.

m. (-यः)
Decay of a family.
E.
वंश, and क्षय decline.

f. (-री)
The manna of the bambu.
E.
वंश the bambu, and क्षीर milk; being of a milky colour.

n. (-त्रं)
A genealogical table or list, the history of a race or dynasty, &c.
E.
वंश, and चरित्र an account.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
1 Sprung from a good family.
2 Produced by the bambu.
nf. (-जं-जा)
Bambu manna.
E.
वंश a bambu, lineage, &c., and ज born, produced.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Who or what supports a family.
2 Carrying or holding a bambu, &c.
E.
वंश, and धर what holds.

f. (-का)
A pipe, a reed or flute.
E.
वंश a bambu, नाल a tube, कन् aff. fem. form.

n. (-कं)
Yellow orpiment.
m. (-कः)
A sort of fish, (Cynoglossus lingua, HAM.)
E.
वंश a bambu, and पत्र a leaf, the shape of the fish resembling that of the leaf.

n. (-तं)
A species of the Atyaṣṭī metre.

f. (-रा)
Family, lineage, descent.
E.
वंश, and परम्पर successive.

n. (-ज्यं)
Hereditary estate.
E.
वंश, and भोज्य to be possessed.

f. (-ना)
An earthy concretion of a milk-white colour, formed in the hollow of the bambu, and known by the name of bambu manna.
E.
वंश the bambu, रुच to shine, aff. युच्; also र being changed to ल, वंशलोचना.

f. (-ना)
The manna of the bambu: see the last.

n. (-नं)
Increasing or exalting a family.
E.
वंश, and वर्द्धन augmenting.

f. (-तिः)
1 A clump of bambus.
2 Family, descent.
E.
वंश, and वितति extent.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Of a good family.
2 Of a good bambu, (made, constructed.)
E.
वंश, and विशुद्ध pure.

f. (-द्धिः)
Prosperity of a family.
E.
वंश, and वृद्धि increase.

f. (-का)
1 The bambu pipe that forms the body of the Vīṇā or lute.
2 Any small bambu pin or stake, as the bar of a cage, &c.
E.
वंश a bambu, and शलाका a pin or bolt.

m. (-रः)
Family usage.
E.
वंश, and समाचार practice.

n. (-लं)
A species of the Jagatī metre.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Having no kindred or family.
E.
वंश, and हीन deprived of.

n. (-ग्रं)
The shoot of a bambu.
E.
वंश, and अग्र point.

m. (-रः)
The shoot of a bambu.
E.
वंश, and अङ्कुर a shoot.

f. (-ली)
A pedigree, a genealogy.
E.
वंश, and आवली a line.

n. (-तं)
A pedigree, a genealogical list, or history.
E.
वंश a family, अनु implying succession, and चरित proceeded.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Belonging or relating to a family, a bambu, &c.
nf. (-कं-का)
Aloe wood.
E.
वंश a bambu, and ठक् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A flute-player, a piper, a fifer.
2 A bambu-cutter, &c.
E.
वंश a pipe, aff. ठक् or ठन्.

m. (-रः)
1 A piper.
2 A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
वंशी, and धर who holds.

mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
1 Of a good family.
2 Of the same family.
m. (-श्यः)
1 A son.
2 A pupil, a scholar.
3 A kinsman, from seven generations above and seven below.
E.
वंश a family, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Most, very much or great.
E.
वंह substituted for वृन्दारक great, and इष्ठन् aff.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Very much or very large.
E.
वंह for वृन्दारक, and ईयसुन् aff.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (वनति वनयति)
1 To sound.
2 To serve, to honour.
3 To help.
4 To be distressed.
(उ) वनु r. 1st and 10th cls. (वनति वनयति)
1 To act, to transact business.
2 To injure;
also r. 8th cl. (वनुते)
To ask or beg.

nf. (-नं-नी)
A forest, a wood, a grove.
n. (-नं)
1 Water.
2 A residence, a dwelling or abode.
3 A house.
4 A cascade or fountain.
E.
वन to sound, to serve, to seek, &c., aff. घञ्.

mfn. subst. (-नः-ना-नं)
Dry fruit.
adj.
Dry, dried.
n. (-नं)
1 Living.
2 Going, moving.
3 A mat of straw.
4 A heavy sea, the rolling of water from wind, &c.; hence the high tide in the Indian rivers, commonly called the Bore.
5 A hole in the wall of a house.
6 A perfume, a fragrance.
mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Relating to a wood, a house, &c.: see वन.
n. (-नं)
A number or multitude of woods.
E.
वै to dry or wither, aff. क्त; form irr.: in other of its applications वन to sound, aff. घञ्; or वन a wood, water, a house, &c., and अण् referential aff.

m. (-चुः)
A species of Arum, (A. colocasia^1.)
E.
वन, and कचु the same.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-री)
A wild elephant.
E.
वन, and करिन् an elephant.

f. (-सी)
Wild cotton, or a plant resembling it, (Hibiscus vitifolius.)
E.
वन a wood, and कार्प्पासी cotton.

m. (-टः)
Wild fowl.
E.
वन, and कुक्कुट a cock.

m. (-जः)
A wild elephant.
E.
वन, and गज an elephant.

n. (-नं)
A thicket.
E.
वन, and गहन the same.

m. (-प्तः)
A spy, an emissary.
E.
वन a wood, and गुप्त concealed.

f. (-गौः)
The Gāyal, (Bos gavæus.)
E.
वन wood, and गो a cow; also वनगव m. (-वः)

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Frequenting forests.
m. (-रः)
A hunter, a forester.
n. (-रं)
A forest.
E.
वन, and गोचर an object, &c.

n. (-नं)
1 Aloe wood or Agallochum.
2 A sort of pine, (Pinus Devadaru.)
E.
वन a wood, and चन्दन Sandal.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Forest, forester, savage.
E.
वन, and चारिन् who goes.

m. (-गः)
1 A wild goat.
2 A hog.
E.
वन a wood, and छाग a goat.

m. (-ट्)
A wood-cutter.
E.
वन, and छिट् who cuts.

m. (-दः)
Cutting timber.
E.
वन, and छेद who cuts.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Wild, forest, born or produced in a wood.
n. (-जं)
A lotus.
m. (-जः)
1 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
2 An elephant.
f. (-जा)
A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus trilobus.)
E.
वन wood, and ज born.

m. (-जः)
A wild goat.
E.
वन a wood, and अज a goat.

m. (-वी)
A wood-man, a forester.
E.
वन, and जीविन who lives.

m. (-क्तः)
A sort of myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.)
f. (-क्ता)
A plant, commonly Aknadhi, (Cissampelos hexandra.)
E.
वन wood, तिक्त bitter.

f. (-का)
A climbing plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.)
E.
कन् in the fem. form added to the preceding.

m. (-दः)
A cloud.
E.
वन water, and द what yields.

m. (-पः)
The Champak, (Michelia Champaca.)
E.
वन a wood, and दीप a lamp or illuminator.

n. (-वः)
A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga, &c.)
E.
वन a wood, and पल्लव a shoot.

m. (-लः)
A hunter, a deer-killer.
E.
वन a wood, and पांशुल a low man.

m. (-पः)
A forest tree.
E.
वन, and पादप a tree.

m. (-शः)
Entering a forest, commencing to live as a hermit.
E.
वन, and प्रवेश entry.

m. (-यः)
The Kökila or Indian cuckoo.
E.
वन a wood, and प्रिय fond of.

m. (-भुक्)
A medicinal root, commonly Ṛṣabha.
E.
वन a wood, भुज् to eat, aff. क्विप्.

f. (-ल्ली)
Wild jasmine.
E.
वन a wood, मल्ली Jasmine.

f. (-का)
A gad fly.
E.
वन a wood, and माक्षिका fly.

f. (-ला)
The chaplet or garland worn by KṚṢṆA.
E.
वन a wood, and माला necklace.

m. (-लः)
A fruit, (Carissa carondas.)
E.
वन wood, and आमल for आमलक myrobalan.

m. (-ली)
KṚṢṆA.
f. (-नी)
1 Dvāraka the capital of KṚṢṆA.
2 A female energy of KṚṢṆA.
E.
वनमाला as above, इनि and ङीष् aff.

m. (-मुक्)
A cloud.
E.
वन water, and मुच् to let loose, क्विप् aff.

m. (-द्गः)
A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus trilobus.)
E.
वन a wood, and मुद्ग kidney-bean.

m. (-तः)
A cloud.
E.
वन water, and मूत sprinkled.

m. (-रः)
A monkey.
E.
वन a wood, रम to play, aff. ड; also वानर.

mf. (-रः-री)
An ape, a monkey.
f. (-री)
Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
E.
वात what relates to a wood, रा to get, aff. क, a Sylvan; or वा implying resemblance, and नर a man, or वन a wood, रत to play, aff. ड, वनर, and अण् pleonasm added.

m. (-जः)
A lion.
E.
वन a wood, and राजन् a sovereign.

mfn. (-जिः-जिः-जी-जि)
Embellishing or beautifying a forest.
E.
वन, राजृ to shine, इन् aff.

mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिणी-र्त्ति)
Residing in the woods.
E.
वन, and वर्त्तिन् who abides.

m. (-ह्निः)
A wood on fire.
E.
वन a forest, and वह्नि fire.

m. (-सः)
Living in the woods, as a hermit, &c.
E.
वन, and वास abode.

m. (-नः)
A civet or pole cat.
E.
वन a wood, वस to dwell, aff. युच्.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Wild, forest, who or what dwells in woods.
m. (-सी)
1 An anchoret, a hermit.
2 A forester.
E.
वन forest, वास abode, aff. इनि.

m. (-लः)
A sort of wild cat, (Felis caracal.)
E.
वन, and विडाल a cat.

m. (-हिः)
Rice growing wild in pools or swamps, and considered by botanists, as the parent stock of all the varieties cultivated in India.
E.
वन wood or water, and व्रीहि rice.

m. (-टः)
A plant, (Ruellia longifolia): see गोक्षुर.
E.
वन a wood, and शृङ्गाट the same plant.

n. (-नं)
A lotus.
E.
वन water, and शोभन adorning.

m. (-श्वा)
1 A jackal.
2 A tiger.
3 A civet or pole cat.
E.
वन a wood, and श्वन् a dog.

m. (-टः)
A sort of pulse, (Ervum hirsutum.)
E.
वन a wood, and सङ्कट what contracts.

m. (-हः)
A multitude of groves or forests.
E.
वन, and समूह a collection.

f. (-नी)
Wild cotton.
E.
वन wild, and सरोजिनी Hibiscus.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Wild, savage, forest or grove-abiding, &c.
m. (-स्थः)
1 A deer.
2 A hermit, an ascetic.
E.
वन (in) a wood, and स्थ what stays.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Being or abiding in a wood.
m. (-यी)
A hermit, an anchoret.
E.
वन, and स्थायिन् who stays.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Situate or being in a forest.
E.
वन, and स्थित् what stays.

m. (-तिः)
1 A tree that bears fruit but no apparent blossoms, as several species of the fig, the jack, &c.
2 A tree in general.
3 An ascetic.
E.
वन forest, and पति lord, सुट् augment.

m. (-सः)
A sort of tall grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
E.
वन wood, and हास a smile, from हस to laugh, with घञ् aff.; also with कन् added, वनहासक.

m. (-म्पः)
Shaking of the trees of a wood by the wind.
E.
वन, and आकम्प trembling.

m. (-खुः)
A hare.
E.
वन a wood, and आखु a rat.

m. (-कः)
A sort of bean, (Phaseolus Moong.)

m. (-टुः)
A blue fly.
E.
वन a thicket, अट to go, कु aff.

n. (-न्तं)
The skirts of a wood.
E.
वन, and अन्त end.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Wood-destroying.
E.
वन, and अभिलाव destruction.

m. (-युः)
A country distinguished for its breed of horses; also वानायु.

m. (-युः)
A country to the north-west of India; also वनायु.

m. (-जः)
A horse of the Vanāyu breed.
E.
वनायु a country, and ज born.

m. (-जः)
A Vānāyu horse, considered as one of a particularly good breed.
E.
वनायु, and ज born.

m. (-कः)
A flower-gatherer.
E.
वन a wood, अर्च्च to go, वुन् aff.

f. (-का)
A sun-flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.)
E.
वन a wood, अल to adorn, aff. वुन्, and fem. form.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Forest, forester, who or what is in a forest.
m. (-यः)
1 A raven, or perhaps more properly a sort of crow.
2 Dwelling in a forest.
E.
वन a wood, and आश्रय abode.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Leading the life of a hermit, &c.
E.
वन, and आश्रित repaired to.

m. (-रः)
A hog.

m. (-निः)
Fire or its deity.
E.
वन to worship, Uṇādi aff. इ.

f. (-का)
A woody place, a grove.
E.
वनी, and कन् added.

m. (-कः)
A beggar; also वनीयक.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Solicited, begged.
2 Served.
f. (-ता)
1 A woman in general.
2 A beloved woman, a wife, a mistress.
E.
वन to ask, aff. क्त.

m. (-ष्ठुः)
The entrails of an animal offered in sacrifice.^1
E.
वन to worship, इष्ठुच् Uṇādi aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-कः)
A beggar, a mendicant.
E.
वन to ask, इन् aff.; क्यच् and वुन् added; also य being changed to प, वनीपक.

f. (-द्रा)
A tree, commonly Karanja.
E.
वने in a wood, क्षुद्रा small.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Who or what inhabits a wood, forest, forester.
m. (-रः)
1 A forester, one of a savage tribe inhabiting woods, a sylvan, a satyr.
2 An imp, a demon.
E.
वने in a forest, and चर who goes.

m. (-ग्र्यः)
An ascetic, an anchorite, a sage.
E.
वनेचर, and अग्र्य chief.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Living in the woods.
E.
वने, शी to sleep, श aff.

m. (-शः)
A part of a thicket.
E.
वन, and एकदेश a part.

m. (-हः)
A rhinoceros.
E.
वन a wood, and उत्साह effort.

m. (-शः)
A part of a thicket.
E.
वन, and उद्देश direction.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Produced in a forest.
f. (-वा)
Wild cotton.
E.
वन a wood, and उद्भव produced.

m. (-काः)
1 A forester.
2 A monkey, an ape.
E.
वन wood, and ओकस् dwelling.

f. (-का)
A parasite plant.
E.
वन्दा the same, कन् aff.

f. (-का)
A parasite plant.
E.
वन्दा, and कन् added.

m. (-थः)
1 A panegyrist, a eulogist, a bard.
2 One deserving praise or eulogium.
E.
वन्द to praise, Uṇādi aff. अथ.

n. (-नं)
1 The face or mouth.
2 Obeisance to a Brahman or superior by touching the feet, &c.
f. (-नी)
1 Reverence, worship, adoring.
2 Begging, soliciting, asking.
3 The hip (?)
4 A drug for reviving the dead.
f. (-ना)
Praise, praising, especially the gods or great men.
E.
वदि to praise, aff. ल्युट् or युच्, fem. aff. ङीष् or टाप्.

f. (-ला)
The ornamented arch of a gate-way.
E.
वन्दन praising, and माला a garland; being hung with flowers on marriages and festival occasions.

f. (-का)
The ornamented arch of a gate-way.
E.
वन्दन praising, माला a garland, कन् aff. in the fem. form.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Praise-worthy, to be eulogised or praised.
f. (-या)
A yellow substance used as a pigment, said in the Tantras to be procured from the head of a cow: see रोचना.
E.
वदि to praise, अनीयर् aff.

f. (-न्दा)
1 A parasite plant, (Epidendrum tessellatum, &c.)
2 Any parasite plant.
3 A female beggar.
E.
वदि to praise, aff. अङ् and टाप्.

m. (-रः)
A parasite plant.
E.
वन्दा the same, ऋ to go or be, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु)
1 Civil, complimentary, polite.
2 Praising, celebrating.
m. (-रुः)
A panegyrist, a bard.
E.
वदि to praise, आरु aff.

f. (-न्दिः-न्दी)
1 A captive, a prisoner, a man or beast confined.
2 A ladder or stairs.
E.
वदि to praise, aff. इन्, and ङीप् optionally added.

m. (-हः)
A house-breaker, especially one who breaks into the place in which the sacred fire is preserved, into an armoury, or a temple.
E.
वन्दि captive, (what is confined or shut up,) and ग्राह who seizes; also वन्दिचौर, &c.

m. (-रः)
A thief, a house-breaker.
E.
वन्दि, and चौर thief; see the last.

m. (-न्दी)
1 A panegyrist, a bard, a herald, a servant whose duty it is to proclaim the titles of a great man as he passes along, or a poet, who sings the praises of a prince in his presence, or accompanies an army, to chaunt martial songs: considered as one of a distinct tribe, he is the son of a Kṣatriya by a Śūdra female.
2 A praiser, a flatterer.
E.
वदि to praise, aff. इन्.

m. (-ठः)
A complimentary stanza, a panegyric, a eulogium, often improvisatore, recited by a bard, &c.
E.
वन्दि a bard, and पाठ reading.

m. (-रः)
A thief, a house-breaker.

mfn. (-न्द्यः-न्द्या-न्द्यं)
To be praised, commendable, laudable.
f. (-न्द्या)
A parasite plant.
E.
वदि to praise, यत् aff., or यक् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-न्द्रः)
A worshipper, a votary, a follower.
E.
वदि to praise, aff. रक.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
Forest, savage, wild, produced in a wood, &c.
f. (-न्या)
1 A multitude of groves.
2 A quantity of water, a flood, a deluge.
3 A plant, (Physalis flexuosa.)
E.
वन a wood, &c., यत् aff.

f. (-न्या)
A multitude of groves or thickets.
E.
वन a wood, यञ् aff. of multitude; also with यत् aff. वन्या.

m. (-त्रः)
A copartner, a coheir, &c.
E.
वत to ask, and रन Uṇādi aff.

m. (-स्थः)
1 The Brahman of the third order, who has passed through the conditions of student and householder, and has left his house and family for lonely meditation in woods and wilds; the hermit, the anchoret.
2 A tree, (Bassia latifolia.)
3 The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.)
E.
वन a wood, अण् aff., वान a solitude in the woods, &c., प्रस्थ who goes forth to, from स्था to stay, with प्र prefix, and क aff.

m. (-यः)
A tree, (Mimusops kauki, Rox.)
E.
वानर a monkey, and प्रिय fond of.

m. (-तः)
A tree, commonly Lodh, (Symplocos racemosa.)
E.
वीनर a monkey, आघात struck, injured.

m. (-न्द्रः)
1 The monkey chief, SUGRĪVA.
2 HANUMĀN.
E.
वानर, and इन्द्र chief.

m. (-लः)
A kind of holy basil, distinguished as the black species of Tulasī, (Ocymum sanctum.)

m. (-त्यः)
A tree bearing fruits from blossoms, as the mango, eugenia, &c.
E.
वनस्पति a tree bearing fruits without blossoms, and ण्य aff.

m. (-रः)
A sort of cane or ratan, (Calamus rotang.)
E.
वन water, ईर aff., and the first vowel made long.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Relating or belonging to water, &c.
m. (यः)
A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
E.
वन water, ढञ् aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Vomited, ejected from the mouth.
E.
वन to vomit, aff. क्त.

m. (-दः)
A dog.
E.
वान्त what is ejected from the mouth, and अद who eats.

f. (-न्तिः)
Vomiting, ejecting from the mouth.
E.
वम to vomit, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-कृत्)
Emetic.
m. (-कृत्)
A thorny plant, (Vangueria spinosa.)
E.
वान्ति vomiting, and कृत् what makes; an emetic.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Emetic.
f. (-दा)
A medicinal plant, commonly Katiuki, (Wrightea antidysenterica; and Colotropis gigantea, BROWN.)
E.
वान्ति vomiting, and द what produces; an emetic.
